picks.headline: llm-gemini 0.35 Adds Support for Gemini 4 Argon
picks.why: Google's new Gemini 4 Argon model is now accessible via the llm CLI tool and API.
picks.title: llm-gemini 0.35

picks.headline: Cloudflare Acquires Deno to Advance Self-Hostable Workers
picks.why: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno to advance self-hostable Workers while sunsetting official Deno runtime development after one year.
picks.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare

picks.headline: Quantized LLM Supply Chain Risk: GGUF Models Lack Build Verifiability
picks.why: Audit reveals zero out of 198 top Hugging Face GGUF models can be independently re-derived bit-for-bit due to missing build environment coordinates.
picks.title: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains

picks.headline: CVE-2026-65616 Details Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities From RL Training
picks.why: Forensic analysis shows how RL/RLHF training configurations create exploitable privilege escalation vulnerabilities in deployed AI agents.
picks.title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)

picks.headline: vLLM Adds Push-Based RDMA KV Transfer for Disaggregated Inference
picks.why: Pushing KV cache directly to decode memory over RDMA improves prefill-decode disaggregation performance across accelerator clusters.
picks.title: Push-Based KV Transfer to Improve TTFT and TPOT for Disaggregated Inference in vLLM

picks.headline: Google DeepMind Releases AI Control Roadmap for Agent Threats
picks.why: DeepMind introduces the TRAIT&R taxonomy to treat advanced internal AI agents as potential insider threats.
picks.title: I Love Google’s Agentic AI Security Roadmap: Adding MAESTRO Will Make It More Powerful — An Open Letter to Google

papers.headline: Continuum Attention Replaces Discrete KV Lookups With Memory Curves
papers.why: Replaces discrete key-value lookups in Transformer decoders with continuous piecewise linear memory curve integration.
papers.title: Continuum Attention

papers.headline: Latent Compaction Uses Test-Time Training for 32x KV Compression
papers.why: Uses test-time training to compress document KV caches up to 32x without updating model weights.
papers.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training

papers.headline: Study Shows NO-THINK RL Reasoning Gains Stem From Thinking Leakage
papers.why: Demonstrates that reasoning gains in non-thinking modes reactivate existing thinking abilities rather than learning novel behaviors.
papers.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
